**Please do not attach game files or links to download them.**

**Game:** (the name as shown in the PicoBoy list)
**PicoBoy version:** (for example v1.0, from the Releases page)
**Does it start?** yes / no
**Picture:** looks right / wrong in some places (where? what do you see?)
**Sound:** fine / wrong / none
**Speed:** full speed / slows down (when?)
**Saving:** (does the game's own save survive switching off? you should see a green SAVED and, in the list, a green "saved")
**How long did you play, and how far did you get?**
**Anything else:**
